description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM, applies global CSS styles, imports the main App component, and renders the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' inside a React StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
